 Stars Shine On Red Carpet At 2026 Korea Grand Music Awards (KGMA) Day 1
 Music 
 Nov 07, 2026 
 by S Nam 
 Celebrities have gathered together for this year’s Korea Grand Music Awards (KGMA)!
 The 2026 KGMA is a two-day event taking place at Gocheok Sky Dome. Day 1 of the awards ceremony was hosted by RESCENE’s Woni and actress Nam Ji Hyun .
